place_fields.vibe: rocky hill trek with historic temple surroundings
place_fields.summary: Avani Betta is a short rocky hill trek near Avani in Kolar district, with historic temple structures at the base and scenic views from the hill.

planning_attributes.description: Trek starting point for the Avani Betta hill trail near the historic temple complex at Avani.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: Avani Betta is about 515 ft high.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Avani is associated with the Ramayana tradition and is described as the birthplace of Lava and Kusha; the hill has the Valmiki Ashram tradition.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Avani in Kolar district by road and proceed to the marked trek start near the base village.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The trail includes rocky and steep sections; monsoon conditions can make the trail slippery.

place_fields.vibe: rocky hill and perennial spring area
place_fields.summary: Antaragange is a rocky hill area near Kolar known for the Kashi Vishweshwara temple, a perennial spring and natural caves used for trekking and adventure activities.

planning_attributes.description: The Antaragange hill area includes the temple, spring-fed water feature, caves and trekking routes.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Antaragange is associated with legends involving Parashurama, Jamadagni and Kartaviryaarjuna; the perennial spring is traditionally associated with sacred Ganga water.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Antaragange is about 3-4 km from Kolar and can be reached from Kolar by road; Kolar also has a railway station.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The hill has steep rocky sections and cave/trekking terrain; use care on the ascent and descend before dark.

place_fields.summary: Anthargange View Point is a viewpoint on the Anthargange hill area near Kolar, overlooking the surrounding rocky hill landscape and countryside.

planning_attributes.description: Scenic viewpoint associated with the Anthargange hill and trekking area near Kolar.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Anthargange from Kolar by road and continue through the hill area to the viewpoint.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The surrounding Anthargange terrain has rocky and steep sections; take care on uneven paths.
